title: Classic Homemade Mayonnaise
summary: Pasteurised egg yolks blended with lemon juice and mustard powder, then oil streamed in until thick.
equipment: food processor or bowl and whisk

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Blitz the yolks, lemon juice, mustard powder, sugar and salt for 10 seconds until even.

steps.title: Add the oil
steps.text: With the motor running, pour in the oil in a very thin stream over about 30 seconds until thick and pale.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scrape down the sides, blitz for 5 seconds more and season with pepper and a few drops more lemon if needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into a bowl and serve with hot chips, or keep in a jar in the fridge.

tips: Have the yolks at room temperature so the sauce thickens easily.
If it splits, whisk 1 tsp water into a clean bowl and slowly whisk the split sauce back in.
safety: Use pasteurised eggs; pregnant women, young children, older people and anyone unwell should skip raw-egg sauces.
For a cooked-yolk version, heat the yolks with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp water over simmering water to 71 °C first.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
